title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: To determine if a dataset is linearly separable, imagine drawing a straight line that separates the two classes without any overlap. If such a line exists, the dataset is linearly separable.

title: Analyzing the Scatter Plot
text: Look at the scatter plot and observe the distribution of the points. Are there any points from different classes that overlap or are very close to each other?

title: Evaluating Separability
text: Based on the scatter plot, can you draw a straight line that separates the two classes without any overlap?
